title: Optimal L2 Regularization in High-dimensional Continual Linear Regression
abstract: arXiv:2601.13844v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We study generalization in an overparameterized continual linear regression setting, where a model is trained with L2 (isotropic) regularization across a sequence of tasks. We derive a closed-form expression for the expected generalization loss in the high-dimensional regime that holds for arbitrary linear teachers. We demonstrate that isotropic regularization mitigates label noise under both single-teacher and multiple i.i.d. teacher settings, whereas prior work accommodating multiple teachers either did not employ regularization or used memory-demanding methods. Furthermore, we prove that the optimal fixed regularization strength scales nearly linearly with the number of tasks $T$, specifically as $T/\ln T$. To our knowledge, this is the first such result in theoretical continual learning. translated_title: 高维持续线性回归中的最优L2正则化
translated_abstract: 我们研究了过参数化持续线性回归设置中的泛化问题，其中模型在一系列任务上使用L2（各向同性）正则化进行训练。我们在高维情形下推导出了期望泛化损失的闭式表达式，该表达式对任意线性教师均成立。我们证明了各向同性正则化在单教师和多个独立同分布教师的设置下都能缓解标签噪声的影响，而此前支持多教师的工作要么没有采用正则化，要么使用了内存开销较大的方法。此外，我们证明了最优固定正则化强度随任务数量T近似线性增长，具体为T/ln T。据我们所知，这是理论持续学习领域中首个此类结果。最后，我们通过线性回归和神经网络的实验验证了理论发现，展示了这一缩放律如何影响模型性能。
tldr: 该论文在高维过参数化持续线性回归中推导出对任意线性教师均成立的期望泛化损失闭式表达式，并首次在理论持续学习中证明了最优L2正则化强度应随任务数T近似线性增长（为T/ln T）。
en_tdlr: This paper derives a closed-form expression for expected generalization loss in overparameterized continual linear regression valid for arbitrary linear teachers, and proves for the first time in theoretical continual learning that the optimal L2 regularization strength scales nearly linearly with the number of tasks, as T/ln T.
